div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 646px; height: 1px; padding-top: 10000px; margin-left: 10000px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, var(--ge-light-color, #ffffff)); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.br:
• Temperature 30–80 °C (Drying 30–50 °C); −/+ in 5 °C, number pad any whole value in range
• Time 1–120 min (Bleaching 1–720 min); −/+ in 1 min
• UV Intensity 10–100 % (−/+ in 5 %), default 30 %
• New step: Heating 40 °C / 10 min (or the forced process); Cooling default 30 °C, Medium
• Max 2 N₂ purges; an N₂ purge only after a Cooling since the previous purge
